title: Compact failure bucketizer and observability playback utility
creator: Aisha Park
description:
Goal: Implement a lightweight failure bucketizer that groups inference failures (timeouts, overload, model rejections, HTTP/gRPC error codes) into compact, human-readable buckets and ship an "observability playback" utility that can rehydrate traces/metrics for a bucket to reproduce and triage issues locally. This ticket covers the classification heuristics, mappings to SLIs/SLOs, a minimal streaming and batch pipeline to produce buckets, and a developer-facing playback CLI + dashboard integration.

Why: Current error dashboards surface raw counts and long tail trace lists. Engineers spend too much time hunting similar incidents; there's no simple way to replay representative traffic slices to reproduce flaky timeouts or model rejection patterns. Compact buckets + playback will reduce MTTR and enable reproducible debugging across runtime, routing, and model layers.
acceptance_criteria: A compact bucketizer runs nightly over 7 days and produces top 50 buckets with labels (primary failure mode, percentile latency, affected route/model)
Each bucket links to 5 representative trace IDs and a small synthesized request batch used by the playback utility
Playback CLI can take a bucket id and re-run requests against a dev runtime env (or a dry-run local simulator) and produce deterministic logs + kv cache hit/miss histogram
A Grafana dashboard panel auto-populates with bucket summaries and SLI exposure (error rate, p95 latency, rps) and is accessible from the incident board
Bucket-to-SLI mapping documented in Confluence and wired into alert annotation rules for two pilot routes
tasks: Define compact bucket schema and scoring function (latency skew, error type, grpc/http code, model reject reason, kv-cache-miss)
Implement batch bucketizer job (Spark/Beam or Flink prototype) + streaming adapter for live buckets
Extend trace enrichment hook to add bucket_id header and representative-sample selector
Build playback CLI that rehydrates request payloads and can target dev/staging/private runtime
Create Grafana panels and an incident-playbook view that surfaces top buckets with drilldown
Run pilot on two high-traffic routes and validate MTTR improvement metric
updates: 2026-02-10: Kickoff. Drafted goal and initial heuristics. Spoke with PM (Ravi) to scope pilots to /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings routes.
2026-02-18: Chose scoring fields: failure_mode, p95_latency_delta, rps_impact, unique_models_count, kv_miss_rate. Decided on compact bucket id format: <mode>-<shorthash>.
2026-02-22: Prototype batch job implemented on daily trace export. Initial buckets look sensible; top bucket is 'timeout-9af3' covering 12% of timeout SLI breaches.

2026-02-26: Design review with Observability and Runtime teams. Decision: playback will support two modes — 'dry-run' (simulator) and 'direct' (replay to dev runtime). Security requires that direct mode only targets non-prod endpoints and strips customer PII.
2026-03-02: Added representative-sample selector — picks five traces per bucket by minimizing sample distance on fingerprints. Early manual replays reproduce kv-cache cold start timeouts locally.
2026-03-06: PR opened for bucketizer core: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/673 (unit tests + integration with trace-exporter).
2026-03-09: Pilot blocked on metrics schema change (we need kv_cache_miss counter in per-route metrics). Raised dependency ENG-97211 for metrics producer change.
2026-03-10: Work resumed with a temporary enrichment that computes kv miss from trace spans. Playback CLI alpha available at github.com/redwood-inference/observability/tree/playback-alpha
comments: PM Ravi: Good scope — ensure we measure MTTR delta after pilot. Also please include a non-technical summary for CSMs.
Runtime lead Mei: For direct replays, ensure circuit-breaker rules prevent accidental overload on dev clusters. We need quota checks in CLI.
Design (Lena): Add a compact visualization for buckets — small glyphs to indicate primary failure cause and severity. Avoid large tables.
Oncall Chris: Recommend including 'recent deploy id' in bucket metadata to correlate regressions with rollouts.
notes: Trade-offs: compact buckets risk over-aggregation (masking multiple causes). To mitigate, bucket scoring includes a homogeneity metric and will split buckets above a heterogeneity threshold.
Privacy: playback CLI strips tokens/PII and supports a 'redaction' mode. Constrained by security review timeline if we expand to direct replays for customer-owned private deployments.
Rollout plan: start with read-only dashboards, then enable playback dry-run; if pilot succeeds schedule a broader rollout and onboard SLO annotation rules.
